intro.text: Fumes from flammable agents which, if fanned by rotor or propeller wash, could endanger persons or property on the surface or in other aircraft.
Volcanic eruptions that could endanger airborne aircraft and occupants.
Hijacking incidents that may endanger persons or property on the surface, or airborne aircraft and occupants.
Aviation or ground resources engaged in wildfire suppression.
Aircraft relief activities following a disaster.
Aerial demonstrations or major sporting events.
